approach: All catalogue records screened locally against public Internet Archive and a bounded Crossref journal-article metadata corpus. OCR f/£ repair, line-break repair, shortened imprint-free title variants, phonetic token normalization and near-spelling retrieval precede fuzzy title, creator and publication-year scoring. Two distinct best metadata candidates retained. This is candidate generation, not a verified catalogue crosswalk.
confidence: Heuristic tiers, not calibrated probabilities. High requires close title, creator overlap and same/adjacent year; medium supports a plausible work connection; low can be an OCR, translation, edition or false-match lead.
imagePolicy: Source thumbnails are reference-copy images. Page type and edition match unverified unless separately researched. No image inferred to depict the family copy.
copyCountPolicy: External record, digitization and search-result counts are never converted into surviving physical copies.
scope: All family catalogue records were screened locally, not individually searched on the web. Internet Archive corpus source selection is recorded in the earlier broad-research/book-cache/ia-corpus-log.json. The added bounded Crossref journal corpus and its requests are recorded in full-catalogue-pass/cache/crossref-retrieval-log.json. Unmatched records may be absent from these corpora, have unreadable OCR, or need other sources; this is not an exhaustive search of world catalogues.
containerPolicy: Host-publication candidates are inferred from an OCR offprint citation. They identify a possible reading source, not the article, edition, physical offprint or survival count. No individual external request was sent for these records; matching uses the cached Internet Archive corpus.
externalSearchScope: One family title was individually probed through Crossref and OpenAlex. All 49,780 family records were locally screened; the main external activity was public-corpus retrieval (93 Crossref batch requests plus journal discovery), not 49,780 web searches.
reviewedFalsePositiveProtections: Spot-checking exposed publisher/imprint words matching unrelated book reviews. Three named regression records were rechecked after removing imprint variants: Das Gold and Mathematische Schwingungslehre no longer matched unrelated reviews; Molecular rays now matched a source with that title. Common publication-format tokens are excluded. Low-confidence related-title mismatches still remain and are explicitly labelled.
falsePositivePolicy: Low-confidence candidates can be false matches. Imprints and common publication-format words are removed before title matching; apparent book reviews and host-journal leads are separately labelled. No automatic candidate is marked verified.
